docs.api.default.description: The default value of a prop in the API reference. The value is code, such as a string or a number. Write it in lowercase.

docs.api.deprecated.description: The badge next to the name of a prop in the API reference when the prop is old and a later version removes it. Write it in lowercase.

docs.api.events.description: The heading of the list of the event props of a component in the API reference, such as onChange.

docs.api.htmlAttributes.description: The sentence at the end of the API reference of a component that also takes the attributes of its HTML element.

docs.api.htmlAttributesOf.defaultMessage: Also takes the HTML attributes of {tags}.
docs.api.htmlAttributesOf.description: The sentence at the end of the API reference of a component. The tags are the HTML elements of the component, as code, such as <div>.

docs.api.noProps.defaultMessage: This component takes no props of its own.
docs.api.noProps.description: The text of the API reference of a component that has no props or events of its own.

docs.api.props.description: The heading of the list of the props of a component in the API reference. A prop is an input of the component.

docs.api.reference.description: The heading of the part of a page that lists each component with its props and its events.

docs.api.required.description: The word next to the name of a prop in the API reference when the component needs a value for the prop. Write it in lowercase.

docs.app.docs.description: The name of the documentation site. It shows in the title of the browser tab, in the header of the home page, and at the top of the sidebar.

docs.app.notFound.description: The title of a page whose path has no page of the docs. It shows in the header and in the title of the browser tab.

docs.app.pageTitle.description: The title of the browser tab on a page of the docs. The page is the name of the page, such as Button.

docs.app.section.components.description: The name of the section of the sidebar and of the home page that lists the components.

docs.app.section.modules.description: The name of the section of the sidebar and of the home page that lists the modules, such as the grid and the chart.

docs.app.section.primitives.description: The name of the section of the sidebar and of the home page that lists the primitives: the low-level parts that the components use.

docs.app.section.providers.description: The name of the section of the sidebar and of the home page that lists the providers: the parts that give settings to the parts under them.

docs.app.section.structure.description: The name of the section of the sidebar and of the home page that lists the layout parts, such as a stack or a split.

docs.app.toggleSidebar.description: The name of the button in the header that shows or hides the sidebar on a wide screen.

docs.direction.label.description: The label of the setting that lays out the docs site left to right or right to left.

docs.direction.ltr.description: The option of the direction setting that lays out the site left to right.

docs.direction.rtl.description: The option of the direction setting that lays out the site right to left.

docs.example.hideCode.description: The label of the button under an example that hides the source code of the example.

docs.example.playground.description: The heading of the first example of a page, where the reader changes the props of the component to see the result.

docs.example.reset.description: The label of the button that puts an example back in its first state, such as after a close or a delete.

docs.example.showCode.description: The label of the button under an example that shows the source code of the example.

docs.home.intro.defaultMessage: Each component, module, structure, provider, and primitive of ui, with a playground, examples, and an API reference.
docs.home.intro.description: The text at the top of the home page of the docs, above the list of the pages. ui is the name of the library.

docs.notFound.body.defaultMessage: No page of the docs is at this path.
docs.notFound.body.description: The text of the page that shows for a path that has no page of the docs.

docs.notFound.home.description: The text of a link on the not-found page. The link goes to the home page, which lists each page of the docs.

docs.pageError.body.defaultMessage: Reload the page to try again.
docs.pageError.body.description: The text under the heading of a page of the docs that fails to render.

docs.pageError.heading.description: The heading that shows in place of a page of the docs that fails to render.

docs.pageError.reload.description: The label of the button that loads the page again after an error.

docs.playground.component.description: The label of the field of a playground that selects the component to show, on a page with more than one component.

docs.playground.default.description: The badge next to the option of a field of a playground that the component uses when the prop is unset.

docs.playground.fromSizeClass.description: A value of a prop that holds from a screen width up, such as "Horizontal from medium". The value and the size class are names from the code, in English.

docs.playground.none.description: The option of a field of a playground that leaves the prop unset, when an unset prop has no value.

docs.playground.off.description: The option of a field of a playground that sets a true or false prop to false.

docs.playground.on.description: The option of a field of a playground that sets a true or false prop to true.

docs.playground.props.description: The name of the row of fields above a playground. Each field sets one prop of the component: one of its inputs.

docs.playground.size.lg.description: The option of the size field of a playground for the large size.

docs.playground.size.md.description: The option of the size field of a playground for the medium size.

docs.playground.size.sm.description: The option of the size field of a playground for the small size.

docs.playground.size.xl.description: The option of the size field of a playground for the largest size.

docs.playground.size.xs.description: The option of the size field of a playground for the smallest size.

docs.search.button.description: The label of the button at the top of the sidebar that opens the search of the docs.

docs.search.kind.component.description: The kind of a search result that is the API reference of a component: its props and its events.

docs.search.kind.event.description: The kind of a search result that is an event prop of a component, such as onChange.

docs.search.kind.example.description: The kind of a search result that is an example on a page of the docs.

docs.search.kind.page.description: The kind of a search result that is a page of the docs, such as Button.

docs.search.kind.prop.description: The kind of a search result that is a prop of a component: an input of the component.

docs.search.kind.tab.description: The kind of a search result that is a tab of a page of the docs, such as Sorting.

docs.search.placeholder.defaultMessage: Search pages, examples, props, and events
docs.search.placeholder.description: The placeholder of the search field of the docs, and its name. Props and events are the inputs of a component.

docs.tabs.sections.description: The name of the list of tabs at the top of a page of the docs. Each tab shows one part of the page.
